description: This file defines the MockLight class, which extends MockZigbeeDevice and represents a mock implementation of a Zigbee light device. It includes methods to turn the light on or off, toggle its state, set and get light level as a percentage, and simulate power consumption measurements. The class constructs a Zigbee endpoint with various clusters such as OnOff, Level, Metering or Electrical Measurement, and others, to simulate a real Zigbee light device.

classes.name: MockLight
classes.description: A mock implementation of a Zigbee-based light device for testing purposes, with control over power, level, and measurement features.

methods.name: isOn
methods.description: Checks if the light is currently on.

methods.name: turnOn
methods.description: Turns the light on and prints confirmation.

methods.name: turnOff
methods.description: Turns the light off and prints confirmation.

methods.name: setLightLevel
methods.description: Sets the light's brightness level as a percentage.

methods.name: getOnLevel
methods.description: Returns the current ON level of the light.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the current brightness level as a percentage.

methods.name: setWatts
methods.description: Sets the power measurement, either via metering or electrical measurement cluster.

methods.name: getWatts
methods.description: Retrieves the current power usage measurement.
